Zara (People Ops): Quick heads-up: we've published a targeted handbook addendum today covering Performance Cycle tempo changes, manager calibration responsibilities, and a short compliance micro-training for conflicts of interest. Link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/perf-cycle-addendum-2026 :memo:
Andre V: Is this a wording change or are we changing how calibration meetings are recorded?
Zara (People Ops): Both. Clarifies manager notes required for calibration + introduces an optional calibration rubric template. Also mandatory 12-minute micro-course on conflicts of interest for all people managers.
Jules M: 12 minutes async? Where's the course?
Zara (People Ops): LMS -> "Manager Essentials: Conflicts". One 7-min video + 3 quiz Qs. Completion tracked automatically. Link in handbook.
Legal (Kasia): Do we need to capture manager attestations for CI training? Any record retention specifics?
Zara (People Ops): Yes, managers must click "Acknowledge" after completion. Records retained for 3 years for auditing. We worked with Legal on retention and data minimization.
Andre V: Scope: all people managers incl IC managers?
Zara (People Ops): All employees with a direct report in HRIS flagged as "manager" — includes IC-managers and people with headcount ownership. Contractors excluded.
Jules M: For calibration notes, can we attach private comments (not visible company-wide)?
Zara (People Ops): Calibration notes stored in a manager-only view. Only Opt-in excerpts (anonymized) flow to cross-team calibration exports.
training-bot: Reminder set: Managers must complete "Conflicts of Interest (12m)" by 2026-05-10.
Andre V: How will I show completion for my managers in case I need to present to execs?
Zara (People Ops): Manager dashboard will show per-manager completion + timestamp. You can export with `peopleops-cli export --type training --manager andre@redwood.ai --format csv > andre-training.csv`
Jules M: Any penalties?
Zara (People Ops): No punitive actions. Managers missing the deadline get reminders, then an HR check-in. We're trying to avoid access impacts.
Legal (Kasia): Also added a short FAQ about high-risk vendor relationships in Appendix C of the addendum. Please review if you manage vendor contracts.
Payroll Team: FYI — no comp changes in this update, just process and documentation updates. We'll coordinate if anything changes later.
Andre V: Accessibility request: captions + transcripts?
Zara (People Ops): Captions live, transcripts (EN/ES/FR) by EOD tomorrow.
Jules M: Can we get a one-pager summary to forward to my skip-levels?
Zara (People Ops): Yes, dropping a manager one-pager now: https://redwood-assets.s3/peopleops/perf-calibration-onepager.pdf :paperclip:
Andre V: Thanks — pinging my directors.
Zara (People Ops): Final note: if you have team-specific legal questions, ping Legal (Kasia) or open a ticket using the "policy-review" form linked in the addendum. Closing loop — will send a mid-window reminder next week. :white_check_mark:
